fusions.name: Burr Bite
fusions.desc: Bites one enemy for 26 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Marked] by clinging burrs for 10 seconds. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Raised Hackles
fusions.desc: Bristles with thorns, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Faithful Canopy
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power for 10 seconds. You restore 8 health.

fusions.name: Briar Hound
fusions.desc: A hound grown from briar fights beside you, biting an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. What it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
